trial.prompt:
本版本在既有批量审批（POST /purchases/bulk-approve）、批量驳回（POST /purchases/bulk-reject）、重新提交（POST /purchases/{id}/reopen）与批量改派（POST /purchases/bulk-reassign）的基础上，新增批量调整成本中心：POST /purchases/bulk-cost-center，请求体严格为 {"ids":[...],"costCenter":"CODE"}，ids 为 1..100 个不重复的采购单 ID，costCenter 为 1..100 字节。只有已认证的 approver 可以调用。每个目标必须是当前租户中他人创建、状态为 submitted 的采购单；costCenter 必须是当前租户 CostCenter 表中 active 的 code。成功后把全部目标的 Purchase.costCenterId 设为 costCenter，status 及其他列都不变；任一目标不符合条件或 costCenter 不合法时返回 4xx，数据库全部不变（全批原子）。请求体、身份、报文上限和 Idempotency-Key 校验由共享 HTTP 适配器 protocol.Param 完成（路径 /purchases/bulk-cost-center，参数名 costCenter），新路径通过它注册。成功返回 200，响应为 {"updatedIds":[按字典序排序的 ID],"costCenter":CODE}。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同一 actor 以同一 key 重放同一请求（ID 集合与 costCenter 都相同）时，返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同 key 不同请求（ID 集合或 costCenter 不同）返回 409。不同 actor 使用同名 key 互不影响。幂等结果与调整在同一事务中写入 ActionRequest：operation 为 "bulk-cost-center.v7"，tenantId、actorId、key 分别为当前租户、当前用户和 Idempotency-Key 原值，response 为响应 JSON 对象，每个成功的新请求恰好一行。ActionRequest 写入失败时返回 503 且数据库全部不变，故障移除后同 key 可重试。并发：同 key 同请求两次均 200 且只提交一次；不同 key 把同一批采购单改到不同成本中心时两次都 200，最终这些采购单的 costCenterId 都等于其中一个请求的 costCenter。调整后的采购单仍可被批量审批、批量驳回。requester 调用返回 403，未认证返回 401；客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。批量审批、批量驳回、重新提交、批量改派与原有 API 行为保持不变。
Add the bulk cost-center Action described above to the existing service.
Read the existing code first and follow its conventions.
The database uses guarded RLS. The shared HTTP adapter in internal/protocol validates input and binds demo identity; register the new path with protocol.Param.
Only edit/add internal/candidate/ Go code. All other exports, dependencies, Git settings and tests are protected.
Preserve the existing APIs, including bulk-approve, bulk-reject, reopen and bulk-reassign.
Do not commit/push, read credentials, other checkouts or evaluator materials; do not use other agents.
Use go build ./... and go test ./... as needed. Private database credentials are unavailable during generation. The public SQL schema is in SCHEMA.sql.
Capability: protected internal/opdef is the reviewed operation catalog and already contains the entry for the operation in this task; protected internal/opkernel executes catalog entries: New(ctx,pool), Request and Executor.Run(ctx,identity,name,key,request). The existing operations are served through the kernel by internal/candidate; serve the new one the same way. opkernel.Rejection is distinct from protocol.Rejection; adapt at your boundary.
This is a trusted-code pilot; directory export alone does not enforce host or network isolation.
